title: Almanac profile
description: S10: the owner's opinions about ranking (R10). Device owned, local, versioned, never sent anywhere. Lean and source facts stay in the repo's sources.json; this file only holds what the owner has tuned. Every object is closed except topics, trust and boosts entries which use additionalProperties/items on purpose so new topic buckets and trust overrides are a settings action, not a code change (DESIGN-v1.1 section 9 item 2). Key patterns that additionalProperties cannot express (topic id shape, cross references) are checked by validate.js's checkIntegrity, mirroring contract/validate.py's two-phase approach.

profile_version.description: S10: this profile's own version number, one higher every save. The version history keeps every past value, append only.

topics.description: Ranking engine input (DESIGN section 4): per bucket affinity weight and recency half-life. Keyed by topic id, open set so adding a bucket needs no code change. must_know's affinity is zeroed by convention (OWNER-BRIEF derived); its floor comes from floor_slots, not affinity.

trust.description: R10: trust is device owned, keyed by source id (sources.json owns the id, lean is repo owned). A multiplier; a source with no entry here ranks at the ranker's default of 1.0.

boosts.description: Flat boosts (DESIGN section 4): a capped additive term the ranker applies when a story matches.

seen_penalty.description: R17: two weighted signals. opened takes the full penalty, shown (on screen 2s+, scrolled past) a smaller incremental one.

utc_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, second precision, Z suffix. Matches contract/pool.schema.json's utc_timestamp.

floor_slots.description: Guaranteed slot count at the top of the front page (must_know). Absent or 0 means no floor.
